ficha.ayuda_texto: View this announcement’s rules, requirements and documents. This page does not decide admission; confirm deadlines and stages in the official publication.
ficha.inicio: Select a recruitment notice and its version to consult the rules.
ficha.denegado: You do not have permission to consult this version. Request access from the person responsible for permissions.
ficha.error: This version could not be consulted. Select Retry. If the problem continues, contact IT.
ficha.invalida: The recruitment notice or its version is invalid. Return to the list and select a specific version.
ficha.vacio: This version was not found. Return to the list and check the selected notice.
ficha.sin_requisitos: This version has no requirements in this view. Consult its rules.
ficha.fases_pendientes: Awaiting the process definition. The workflow reference does not include the stages themselves.
ficha.cobertura_pendiente: The vacancy, job offer and post details are missing. Check the published rules.
ficha.siguiente_pendiente: Check the published rules to confirm stages and vacancies. Contact the responsible team if details are missing.
